newsitem.title: USA: Mills Corp plans another Texas mega-mall.
newsitem.headline: Mills Corp plans another Texas mega-mall.

text.p: Mills Corp said Wednesday it acquired an option to buy more than 500 acres of land in Katy, Texas, near Houston, to develop a two-million-square-foot mega-mall.
The Arlington, Virginia-based company said it would invest nearly $250 million in the project, which should be completed in late 1998 or the first quarter of 1999.
The mall will draw 16 to 18 million visitors a year and employ about 4,000, Mills said.
Mills said it would close on the property in six months to a year.
Mills is developing a similar mall in Grapevine, Texas, near Dallas, scheduled to open in October 1997.
The company has built five mega-malls in the United States. It said it now has two under construction and is planning three more, including the one in Katy.
